task: Wire workflow YAML validation into CI and add a wiring guard for the scripts/ci family (issue #3330)

events.content: Wire scripts/validate_workflows.py into the pr-validation validate-pr job and add tests/ci/test_ci_scripts_are_wired.py

lessons: A guard with passing tests and no call site is not half-finished, it is unverified: its tests exercise the interface while the scope, which is where #3329's ratchet was wrong by a factor of two, goes unexercised until something actually runs it.
